customer_jane: Hi team — our March 8 invoice shows ~1,200 extra tokens for a streaming session (sess_9b3f). Dashboard shows ~900 tokens for the same session. This was an SSE stream where the client canceled mid-response. Can someone explain the delta?

maria_support: Sorry about that — can you paste the session id + approximate timestamp? We'll pull logs.

customer_jane: sess_9b3f, started 2025-11-03T14:22:10Z, canceled by client at ~14:22:45Z. Attached our client log: it reconnects once briefly then cancels.

customer_jane: client log snippet:
```
GET /v1/stream?model=redwood-std&sess=sess_9b3f
...
recv: data: {"tokens": 312}
(reconnect)
recv: data: {"tokens": 588}
user cancels socket
```

maria_support: thanks. tagging billing + runtime: @devin_billing @raj_eng — can you take a look? Looks like a classic stream-close counting mismatch.

devin_billing: pulling ledger for sess_9b3f now. Can you also export the server-side event stream for that session (raw events) and any finalize events? I'll diff against invoice lines.

raj_eng: quick summary from runtime POV: billing counts tokens when a stream is finalized server-side (finalize event). We saw a race where the runtime emitted two finalize events for the same logical generation when a client reconnects during cleanup. On retry/replay the last buffer can get re-emitted and then finalized again, causing an extra ~batch worth of tokens.

raj_eng: repro notes (what I ran locally):
```
# simulate SSE open + partial chunk, then client reconnect + cancel
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?sess=sess_local\" \
  --data-binary @payload.json
# server log shows: emit chunk, mark finalize -> metrics increments tokens
# on client reconnect server replays last buffer and marks finalize again -> duplicate count
```

maria_support: do we have a guard to make finalize idempotent?

raj_eng: not for this edge path — current finalize flow is eventual and uses an in-memory window; if the process restarts or there are concurrent workers it can race. Fix is straightforward: check ledger.finalized boolean (or store final_event_id) and ignore duplicates. I'll open a runtime PR and a reconciliation fix to dedupe invoice-facing rows by (session_id, final_event_id).

devin_billing: thanks. For this customer, we should verify invoice lines and then offer a credit if dup detected. I'll run a quick query to look for two finalize events within 5s with overlapping token counts for sess_9b3f.

metering_bot: ledger event dump: ["sess_9b3f","event_453","tokens:588","finalize"], ["sess_9b3f","event_454","tokens:612","finalize"] - two finalize events within 4s.

devin_billing: yep that's the duplicate. Invoice pulled sum(588+612)=1200ish while dashboard shows the post-deduped stream 900.

maria_support: proposed customer message: "We identified duplicated finalize events for your streaming session which led to double-counting. We're issuing a credit for the duplicate tokens and tracking a runtime fix to prevent recurrence." ok with that?

customer_jane: thanks, yes please credit. Also would like to know what caused the reconnect — our client did reconnect briefly because of a mobile signal drop.

raj_eng: action items:
- I will open PR to make finalize idempotent and add a test for replayed final events.
- Add reconciliation rule to dedupe by (session_id, final_event_id) for backfill.
- Add streaming telemetry flag "duplicate_final_detected" for the last 30 days to help ops.

devin_billing: I'll create BILL-379, draft a credit for duplicate tokens for customer_jane, and ask finance to apply. Maria, please confirm customer permission to apply a credit and we'll close the ticket once applied.

maria_support: confirmed, customer_jane OK to apply credit. I've added that to BILL-379.

customer_jane: appreciate the quick turnaround. Any ETA on the runtime fix?

raj_eng: short-term: reconciliation credit within 48 hours. Long-term: runtime PR targeting next patch release (2 releases out) — ETA ~1 week for PR + canary, then rollout. Will post PR link here once opened.

maria_support: leaving notes for the invoice team and closing loop once credit is applied. If you see similar sessions, ping this thread. :thumbsup:

customer_jane: great, thanks all.

(maria_support) [closed on BILL-379]: credit applied; customer invoice updated.
